comparison_condition: existing frozen original-prompt Core10 MPDS n=3 outputs
selection_rules: Reuse the prespecified Core10 stochastic-replication subset rather than selecting cases based on de-leaking outcomes.
Require existing original-prompt MPDS outputs at three replicates for every selected case.
Include both reviewer-relevant manuscript examples: repository Case 1 and PBA Case 8.
Cover multiple battery chemistries, ion carriers, material classes, prompt-leakage mechanisms, and task types.
Include a lower-risk case, Case 29, to avoid testing only extreme solution-cue prompts.
Keep inference case-clustered at n=10 and do not treat 30 outputs as independent cases.
execution_guardrails: Do not alter membership or order without creating a new versioned config and documenting the reason before viewing de-leaking results.
Do not begin Gemini generation until the lost-in-the-middle batch is complete.
Do not begin generation until all Core10 de-leaked situation and user-context files pass author review and hash validation.
Do not start Claude evaluation before all planned generation outputs and blind packets are complete.
Do not overwrite existing original-prompt or completed generation outputs.
